rules.equivalence: The fleet record book, tenant policies, switchboard, installs, grants and approved path are the compatible standard core.
The upstream notes table is sample app data; every fleet app supplies its own first business-shape migration.
Append-only outbox and proposal events provide durable, deduplicated notice delivery.
Company-scoped schedules and desk-owned schedule functions preserve the standard scheduler behavior.
Immutable document metadata and content hashes back the signed backend-only file surface; bytes remain in the configured object store.
Terminal job transitions and cancellation are guarded by the fleet state machine and desk function.
Each app owns its source rows and provenance while the shared declared-read registry exposes only reviewed reads.
Typed Matrix bus threads and immutable answer intents admit bounded peer payloads without weakening stored fact checks.
